company.title: Who We Are
company.subtitle: Asia's Leading Comprehensive Travel Catering Operator
company.body: TOUR GOURMET UNITED, ("TGU") focuses on high-quality catering operations in airports and travel hubs. Founded in 2018 by senior industry expert Mr. Li Yang, the company is backed by the global evergreen capital Invus. Adhering to the core values of "Professionalism, Quality, Innovation, and Win-win", TGU has rapidly grown into a leader in the travel catering sector within just seven years. Through a powerful brand matrix and deep understanding of specific scenarios, TGU has successfully resolved the operational bottlenecks of traditional brands in the airport format, providing travelers with richer, more convenient, and higher-quality dining choices. To date, TGU has not only successfully introduced the first Michelin two-star restaurant brand to domestic airports but also gathered nearly 100 diversified, international, and Michelin-recognized catering brands, significantly raising the standard of the airport dining experience and repeatedly earning high recognition and awards from airport operators.

items.desc: Mr. Li Yang founded TGU with the ambition to build an Asia-leading travel catering enterprise rooted in China.
The first batch of stores opened at Shanghai Pudong Airport and achieved rapid success.
Consolidated operational foundations during the pandemic, entering multiple new airports with restaurant and lounge formats.
The first international terminal restaurant opened at Pudong Airport, immediately ranking among the top in performance.
Beijing Capital Airport international terminal stores became industry benchmarks.
High-quality travel catering concepts entered second-tier hubs such as Guiyang, Wuxi, and Hangzhou.

leadership.title: Leadership Team
leadership.subtitle: Professional Leadership with International Experience
leadership.intro: TGU's leadership team brings together senior professionals from aviation, airport commerce and premium hospitality. Combining international management experience with strong execution in China, the team integrates strategy, business development and operations to establish dining brands successfully in complex travel hub environments.

points.title: In-Depth Understanding of Aviation
points.body: Senior team members have held management roles at the International Air Transport Association (IATA), Air China and UPS, providing practical knowledge of aviation services, passenger needs and travel hub operations.

points.title: Proven Business Development Capability
points.body: The team brings business development experience from international travel dining operators including SSP and HMSHost. It has led major airport tenders and brand acquisitions, translating terminal traffic and passenger needs into commercially sound brand portfolios.

points.title: Established Operating Expertise
points.body: The team has managed close to 20 chain brands and more than 40 multi-format outlets across Shanghai and Beijing, while also supporting the planning and daily catering operations of several airline lounges.

investor.title: Our Investor
investor.subtitle: Backed by a World-Class Evergreen Fund
investor.body: TGU's strategic investor, Invus, is a global evergreen capital firm focused on long-term value investing since 1985. Invus manages over $10 billion in assets, with teams across the United States, Europe, and Asia. Deeply rooted in the consumer, technology, and healthcare sectors for over 40 years, it has built an outstanding investment track record and industry reputation, particularly in the catering and consumer food sectors. As a long-term shareholder of TGU, Invus brings patient capital, profound industry experience, and a global network of brand and operational resources to the company.

overview.title: What we do
overview.bannerDesc: TGU replaces the one-size-fits-all airport dining model with a curated multi-brand portfolio, giving travellers a genuinely rich and authentic dining experience.
overview.body: TGU focuses on food and beverage operations at airports and travel hubs. Unlike the passive site selection and homogeneous brands that characterise traditional airport dining, TGU builds its model around a curated multi-brand portfolio, tailoring the brand mix to the passenger profile and traffic structure of each terminal. Backed by proven operational capability in the airport environment, we deliver consistently high-quality execution. This integrated approach, from curation and composition through to operations, creates shared value for travellers, brands and airports within the same space.

portfolio.titlePart1: Catering to Global Palates with a Diverse Portfolio of
portfolio.desc: We understand that every traveler has a unique journey and distinct culinary preferences. To cater to the evolving profiles of global passengers, TGU has meticulously curated a comprehensive portfolio of over 70 renowned F&B brands. From Michelin-starred premium Chinese dining and comforting authentic Asian selections, to casual Western restaurants, quick-service concepts, and trending desserts, our all-day, multi-category offerings are designed to satisfy every craving. We are dedicated to providing tailor-made dining choices that transform airport dwell time into a delightful culinary exploration for travelers from all cultural backgrounds.

hero.title: Our Stores & Brands
hero.desc: Step into the thoughtfully crafted spaces where TGU elevates every journey. Each store embodies a distinctive brand story and delivers memorable taste and atmosphere for travelers.

eggbomb.name: EGG BOMB
eggbomb.taglineMain: The pioneer of freshly made hot sandwiches
eggbomb.taglineSub: The king of airport dining efficiency.
eggbomb.intro: Rooted in the philosophy of 'Global Inspiration with Chinese Flavors', EGG BOMB pioneered the freshly made hot sandwich category in airport terminals. We blend authentic Asian tastes with trending global elements, crafting every order on the spot to deliver consistent flavour while minimising wait times, a format suited to the tight schedules of travellers. With a distinctive brand identity, strong visual presence, and proven operational efficiency, EGG BOMB has quickly become one of the highest-performing F&B concepts by revenue per square meter in major airport terminals.

canton8.name: Canton 8
canton8.taglineMain: Michelin-starred Cantonese, now in the terminal
canton8.taglineSub: Classic Cantonese flavours for an unhurried journey
canton8.intro: Canton 8 brings Michelin-starred Cantonese cuisine into the airport, with refined ingredients, authentic craftsmanship and an elegant setting. From classic roast meats to seasonal seafood, every dish upholds the brand's signature standards, redefining what a proper sit-down meal at the terminal can be.

googse.name: Goose Island
googse.taglineMain: Chicago craft beer, right at the gate
googse.taglineSub: A relaxed pour before you fly
googse.intro: Born in Chicago, Goose Island is a globally celebrated craft beer brand. We bring authentic craft culture and a laid-back pub atmosphere into the terminal, pouring a rotating selection of signature and limited brews alongside elevated American-style bites, an easy way to slow down and unwind before a flight.

segafredo.name: Segafredo Caffe
segafredo.taglineMain: Italian specialty coffee in the terminal
segafredo.intro: Segafredo Caffe brings Italian specialty coffee to the airport, combining professional, consistent preparation with convenient service for departing and connecting travellers.

wangshifu.name: Wong Shifu
wangshifu.slogan: Hunan stir-fries with authentic wok flavour
wangshifu.taglineMain: Fresh Hunan flavours from the wok
wangshifu.intro: Wong Shifu centres on Hunan flavours and freshly wok-fried dishes, balancing authentic wok character with efficient airport service for a convenient hot Chinese meal.
